project.name: Multi-Person Money Tracker
project.purpose: Track shared money balances between the sheet owner and multiple people using one separate tracker sheet per person.

participants.YOU: The person whose individual tracker sheet is being used

sheets.name: People_Master
sheets.purpose: Stores the list of people and the corresponding tracker sheet name.

sheets.name: Tracker_Template
sheets.purpose: Master template copied whenever a new person's money tracker is created.
Separate transaction and settlement tracker for one person.

sheets.name: Dashboard
sheets.purpose: Displays the current balance, last settlement, total paid, and total received for every person.

sheets.name: Audit_Log
sheets.purpose: Stores a complete history of additions, edits, deletions, settlements, editor identity, and timestamps.

sheets.name: Settings
sheets.purpose: Stores configurable values such as currency symbol, colors, timezone, protected columns, and owner identity.

rules: When Description changes from blank to non-blank, insert the current date and time.
Do not change the existing timestamp when Description is edited later.
When Description becomes blank, clear Date for the same row.
Protect this column from manual editing.
Accept any meaningful transaction description.
Trim leading and trailing spaces.
A non-empty description creates the Date timestamp.
Clearing the description also clears the Date timestamp.

input_rules: Accept positive, negative, and zero values.
Round displayed values to two decimal places.

meaning.positive: The running balance moves in favour of ME.
meaning.negative: The running balance moves in favour of YOU.

Only_Amount.purpose: Marks only the current row's Amount as individually settled.

calculation_effect.unchecked: The row Amount is included in the running Sum.
calculation_effect.checked: The row Amount is treated as zero for the running Sum.

Only_Amount.effective_amount_rule: Effective_Amount = 0 when Only_Amount is TRUE; otherwise Effective_Amount = Amount.
Only_Amount.important_note: Changing this checkbox on an old row recalculates later running balances. Use Audit_Log to preserve the change history.

Sum.purpose: Shows the running unsettled balance between ME and YOU.
calculation_logic: Start from the most recent completed settlement.
For each row, add Effective_Amount to the previous row's active balance.
Effective_Amount is zero when Only_Amount is checked.
When Settlement is checked on the current row, first save the current balance into Settled_Amount, then display Sum as zero.
The next row starts from zero after a completed settlement.
Sum.protection: Formula/script-controlled; manual editing is not allowed.

Settlement.purpose: Completes settlement of the full running balance up to the current row.
on_check_actions_in_order: Store that balance permanently in Settled_Amount.
Add the current date and time to Settled_On.
Set Paid_By based on the balance before settlement.
Write a detailed event into Audit_Log.
Start the next row's running balance from zero.

on_uncheck_policy.recommended: Do not automatically reverse a completed settlement.
on_uncheck_policy.reason: Automatic reversal can corrupt historical balances and settlement records.
on_uncheck_policy.required_action: Use a controlled Undo Settlement action that logs the reversal.

validation: Do not allow settlement when the balance before settlement is zero unless the user confirms.
Do not allow repeated settlement of the same row.
Lock Settled_Amount, Settled_On, and Paid_By after settlement.

Get.purpose: Shows who should receive money based on the current or settled balance.
Get.source_value_rule: Use Settled_Amount when Settlement is checked; otherwise use Sum.

rules: Insert the current date and time when Settlement changes to checked.
Do not update the timestamp again after settlement is completed.
Do not allow manual editing.
Clear only through a controlled Undo Settlement action.

Paid_By.purpose: Shows who paid the settlement amount.

YOU.condition: Balance before settlement is positive or zero

Notes.purpose: Stores optional remarks or settlement details.

Settled_Amount.purpose: Stores the balance snapshot before Sum is reset to zero.
rules: Copy the balance before settlement exactly, including its sign.
Never use a live formula after settlement.
Keep the value permanently for historical reporting.
Do not overwrite an existing settled amount.

Who_Changed.purpose: Stores the latest identifiable user who changed monitored fields in the row.
rules: Update whenever a monitored column is changed.
For deletion of row content, update Audit_Log before clearing the row.
Keep only the latest editor in this column.
Use Audit_Log for complete edit history.
Who_Changed.implementation_note: The ability to identify the editor can depend on the spreadsheet account type, sharing permissions, and automation authorization.

new_transaction: Amount is formatted with sign, currency symbol, and color.
Audit_Log receives an ADD or EDIT event.
edit_transaction: Allow changes only to editable columns.
Recalculate Sum and Get from the edited row downward.
Do not modify original Date unless Description is cleared.
Record old value, new value, editor, and timestamp in Audit_Log.
delete_transaction_content: Record the previous row values in Audit_Log.
Clear Date when Description becomes blank.
Do not silently delete settlement history.
individual_amount_settlement: Treat that row's Amount as zero in the running balance.
full_balance_settlement: Capture the current balance before reset.

rules: Never allow normal users to edit or delete audit rows.
Create one audit entry for every monitored field change.
Create a unique Settlement_ID for every completed settlement.
Store enough snapshot information to reconstruct what happened.

recommended_features: Highlight negative balances in red and positive balances in green.
Click a person's name to open their tracker sheet.
Show the grand total balance across all people.

rows.explanation: Before settlement, the balance was -₹100.00, so ME pays YOU ₹100.00. The settled snapshot remains -₹100.00 and the active Sum resets to zero.
The previous row completed a settlement, so the new running balance starts from zero.
Only_Amount is checked, so this row's -₹300.00 is not added to the active running balance.

validation_and_safety_rules: Description should be present when Amount, Only_Amount, or Settlement is used.
Calculated and snapshot columns must be protected.
A settled row must not be silently edited.
Editing an old transaction after later settlements should require confirmation and must create an Audit_Log entry.
Do not permanently delete settlement history.
Use unique sheet names and unique Person_ID values.
Use dropdown validation for ME and YOU values where manual selection is ever allowed.
Use one standard timezone for all timestamps.
Create periodic backups or version snapshots.

recommended_future_fields.reason: Provides a permanent unique ID even when rows are moved or sorted.
Shows the most recent edit timestamp directly in the person sheet.
Tracks Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, Card, or Other.
Stores a receipt or payment screenshot link.
Groups expenses such as Food, Travel, Shopping, Rent, and Other.

important_design_decisions.reason: This matches the requested behaviour and prevents old balances from being counted again.

important_design_decisions.decision: Settled_Amount is a permanent snapshot, not a formula.
important_design_decisions.reason: Historical settlements must not change when earlier transactions are edited.

important_design_decisions.decision: Get uses Settled_Amount on settled rows.
important_design_decisions.reason: Because Sum becomes zero after settlement, using only Sum would lose who was entitled to receive the settled money.

important_design_decisions.decision: Paid_By uses the balance before settlement.
important_design_decisions.reason: The payer must be determined before the active balance is reset.
Who_Changed can show only the latest editor, while Audit_Log preserves full history.
